sampling.algorithm: Python random.Random; sorted slot/family strata; two distinct choices, one random leaf each; every available choice in sparse strata; top up each family to 10 percent; top up globally to 1100. Existing audit evidence is a route map only.
sampling.underbarrelAndAmmoBoundary: No underbarrel profile or ammo-linked numeric catalog occurs in this supplied census. Primary grip modifiers remain in scope.
sampling.originalAuditExclusions: Generated/prior-reviewed source leaves were eligible for independent reread; only the five non-displayed project metadata leaves were removed.

comparisonRule.exact: Equal source result and current site value after documented source signs/operations.
comparisonRule.precision: Exact float32 equality in the game unit, with inverse x1000 conversion for milliseconds. L107 and site commit 88bc25d461d62e6fe378deb57a64d2f025663244. No relative tolerance substitutes for this rule.

comparisonRule.unresolved: No qualified comparable scalar or identity/semantic mapping. Kept separate from the four comparison classes and from zero.
comparisonRule.mismatch: A new difference beyond float32 precision without a documented model boundary. None found.

sourceFacts.slotEvidence: Each committed slot file contains path, raw SHA-256, typed offsets, hex bytes and source values. All claimed raw checks were reread by the parent; one consequential operand per nonempty chunk is separately retained.
sourceFacts.neutralGraphChecks: 313 grip-neutral rows received an additional current typed-effect/package-import check: zero corrections. All 156 initial magazine-neutral rows were checked; seven ADS-time rows gained exact operands. Corrected L551-v2 is authoritative.

residualReview.newFinding: Slim Angled sniper base moving-spread default is shadowed by four exact -1 weapon overrides; these match source. Four recoil leaves bind deployed-bipod owners with source exponents 10/30 and Field_b574fa40=true.
residualReview.stateBoundary: L108 in frosty-2026-09-28-L106-L111-orchestrator-trial.json and the existing queue record the operator decision to document mounted/bipod recoil without model changes; deployed state is excluded. Native activation/flag semantics are not established by this sample.

existingDiscrepancies.m121a2: 50 Fast reloadSpeedTier retains the documented generic-tier model. Current replacement time/speed yields about 5.550 s versus the existing approximately 5.546 s model. frosty-site-magazines-2026-09-23.json and ATTACHMENTS.md already record the source-backed proposal; native activation remains unverified. This run does not approve, apply or supersede it.
existingDiscrepancies.m240lIntegerMs: 75 Rnd source time/speed gives 7100.070080561782 ms versus the documented integer 7100 ms contract. This is NOT float32-equivalent and is classified as a documented intentional integer-ms deviation, citing frosty-reload-exceptions-leaves-2026-09-23.json and the integer schema.
existingDiscrepancies.spotting: The four existing SP suppressor candidates remain conditional L47/L49 findings; this run makes no native-winner claim.
